status: proposal with experimental loopback native head worker; not agreed with real Antsand

implemented_boundary.native_head_component_evidence: Registered generated head over HTTP; pinned released head weights with synthetic supplied backbone features and embedding rows. Runtime never infers parity from successful execution.

input.artifact_id: registered feature artifact, not a path or text
input.sha256: Native: canonical registered artifact metadata hash, including feature-byte hash, full input spans, selected question and candidate identities. Simulation retains its fixture payload hash.

request.candidate_ids: ordered unique registered IDs; no labels or executable actions

policy.minimum_logit_margin: finite 0..100; explicit consumer policy, not calibrated confidence

request.identity: 1-64 ASCII letters/digits/dot/underscore/hyphen; boot identities are 32 lowercase hex digits
request.encoding: UTF-8 JSON; duplicate keys, unknown request fields and NaN/Infinity rejected

score_semantics: raw logits in request candidate order; no softmax or calibrated confidence is returned
decision_semantics: Exact top ties abstain; otherwise abstain if top-minus-second logit is below requested margin. Single candidate ranks trivially. Selection is informational, executed is always false.
identity_semantics: Echo expected adapter/worker/model identities and canonical request hash. A restart rejects old boot IDs with RESTARTED. Clients must refresh approved discovery before another attempt; no automatic identity acceptance.
evidence: Input hash, model revision, nullable tokenizer revision, registered evidence/IR IDs, nullable native-library SHA-256 and separately scoped numerical parity. Simulation must say contract_simulation + fixture_replay + NOT_TESTED, with no native library. Artifact retrieval requires separate authorization; responses contain no host paths. Native artifact_id is the exact package manifest SHA-256; ir_id is the call-IR file SHA-256; library_sha256 identifies the sealed bytes actually loaded. Package binds weights, circuit, layout and feature files. Request permutations reorder output only; they do not change the registered head context.
deadline_semantics: timeout_ms bounds the consumer attempt; socket shutdown enforces a total transport deadline, and one absolute monotonic deadline is rechecked inside the publication lock immediately before making a result current. Validation and lock wait consume the same budget; equality with the deadline is expired. Simulated worker checks deadline before publication. No native interruption guarantee exists yet. Native checks before and after execution and before response publication; consumer deadline remains authoritative for transport and validation.
cancellation_semantics: Consumer cancellation/replacement suppresses publication. No native interrupt endpoint; the execution slot and arena remain owned until native C returns, even after client disconnect.
concurrency_semantics: Native loopback worker admits one evaluation, returns BUSY for concurrent evaluation, and limits connection threads to four with two-second absolute connection deadlines; excess connections close. No evaluation queue.
privacy_authorization: Administrator pins an executable local package hash. Not an upload interface or sandbox for untrusted native code. No request bodies logged, model downloads, training or business actions. Supplied features may be private. Remote transport and Antsand authorization remain unimplemented.
connection_scope: Consumer accepts only literal loopback HTTP /evaluate. Real remote exposure and approved adapter execution require a separate authenticated contract; this PR does not deploy or alter running services.
malformed_request_errors: Native malformed requests receive only a fixed error code, without echoed private fields; independent consumer rejects them. Test fixture retains its legacy null-envelope diagnostics.
